model_index_convention: Contiguous zero-based order by original COCO category ID after excluding the parent category. Training must save/verify its own filtered category list.
mapping_notes: All 43 category tokens visually reviewed against four annotated crops per category; this verifies semantics, not every annotation.
1z–7z map to 东/南/西/北/白板/发/中.
1h–8h map to 春/夏/秋/冬/梅/兰/菊/竹; 7h=菊 and 8h=竹.
Some crops contain partial or occluded faces; partial visibility remains a separate data-quality concern.
